extracted.name: Warm Crab Parmesan Dip
extracted.description: This hot crab dip recipe is a huge hit with everyone. Parmesan joins crabmeat at center stage in this crowd-pleasing dip for tortilla chips.
ingredient_lines: 4 cloves garlic, peeled and crushed (or to taste)
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Mix crabmeat, cream cheese, Parmesan cheese, mayonnaise, sour cream, and garlic in a small baking dish.
Bake uncovered in the preheated oven until bubbly and lightly browned, about 45 minutes.
